description: This file contains a function 'promptGatewayConfig' that interactively prompts the user for configuration options related to a gateway setup, including port, bind mode, authentication method, Tailscale exposure, and trusted proxy settings. It manages complex logic for different authentication modes and Tailscale configurations, and integrates with various imported modules for validation, user prompts, and configuration building.

methods.name: promptGatewayConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously prompts the user for various gateway configuration options, including port, bind mode, authentication method, Tailscale exposure, and trusted proxies, then constructs and returns the updated configuration object along with the port and token.
